STRUCTURE — Tailscale skeleton (outcome headline + meta sidebar), Dropbox ordering (results before narrative), Customer.io metric treatment.
A visitor who reads only the headline and the three numbers still gets the whole story.

01 Design and 02 Build are deliberately equal weight — same heading scale, same amount of page. This is the section that decides whether Oju reads as a design shop or a studio that ships. Do not let Build shrink when you fill in real content.

Every [BRACKET] is a slot, and the bracketed sentences are instructions for what belongs there — replace the whole sentence, not just the bracket. Stack names are illustrative; swap for what you actually used.
